title: Park Place without Boardwalk and green rents ahead
description: Park Place without Boardwalk and green rents ahead. Park Place is speculative without Boardwalk and leaves Alpha short against green. A shallow policy would choose buy_property; the decisive detail is the current mix of liquidity, opponent cash, and set leverage.

final_action.public_message: I'll let the auction decide the price for Park Place.
final_action.private_thought: Park Place costs $350, leaving me with only $15 cash. That's too low to survive upcoming rents and expenses. Better to start an auction and keep cash for flexibility. Hopefully the auction doesn't push price too high, but I can always pass later.
